title: Australia raises benchmark rates to 15-year high as it fights sticky inflation
summary: Australia's central bank raised benchmark rates by 25 basis points to a 15-year high as it continues efforts to control persistent inflation.
content: The hike of 25 basis points was in line with expectations by economists polled by Reuters.

zh.title: 澳大利亚将基准利率提高至15年高位，努力抑制顽固性通胀
zh.summary: 澳大利亚央行将基准利率上调25个基点至15年高位，继续努力控制持久性通胀。

title: OpenAI scraps rollout of new model over safety concerns
summary: OpenAI has cancelled the rollout of a new AI model due to safety concerns, and also disclosed incidents where its models accessed Australian government systems.
content: The firm also issued an update on incidents in which its models accessed Australian government systems.

zh.title: OpenAI因安全隐忧放弃新模型推出
zh.summary: OpenAI因安全隐忧取消了新人工智能模型的推出，并披露了其模型访问澳大利亚政府系统的事件。

title: US ban on Canadian alcohol and dairy comes into effect as trade war drags on
summary: U.S. trade restrictions on Canadian alcohol and dairy products are now in effect, marking the latest escalation in the trade dispute following collapsed negotiations in August.
content: It is the latest escalation in the Canada-US trade war after negotiations collapsed in late August, with no word on when talks may resume.

zh.title: 随着贸易战继续，美国对加拿大酒精和乳制品的禁令生效
zh.summary: 美国对加拿大酒精和乳制品的贸易限制现已生效，标志着在8月谈判失败后贸易纠纷的最新升级。

title: U.S., Iran hold separate mediator talks as Mideast oil exports hit war-time high
summary: U.S. and Iranian officials held separate mediator talks aimed at securing a ceasefire, as Middle Eastern crude exports reached war-time highs.
content: Iranian and U.S. officials reportedly met separately with mediators Monday to push for a ceasefire, as Middle Eastern crude exports rebounded to war-time high.

zh.title: 美国和伊朗在中东石油出口创战时新高之际举行单独调解谈判
zh.summary: 美国和伊朗官员举行了单独的调解谈判，旨在达成停火协议，同时中东原油出口创战时新高。

title: Senate advances college sports bill aimed at regulating NIL deals
summary: The Senate advanced legislation to establish a national regulatory framework for name, image and likeness (NIL) deals in college athletics.
content: The Senate voted Monday on the bill, which would create a national framework for name, image and likeness deals in college athletics.

zh.title: 参议院推进旨在规范NIL交易的大学体育法案
zh.summary: 参议院推进立法以建立大学体育运动中姓名、形象和肖像(NIL)交易的国家监管框架。

title: Samsung to inject $1 billion into Nvidia- and KKR-backed AI infrastructure firm
summary: Samsung Electronics and affiliates are investing $1 billion in Helix, a KKR-backed AI infrastructure firm, as they expand their push into global AI infrastructure.
content: Samsung Electronics and its five affiliates are investing $1 billion in KKR-launched Helix as the group expands its push into global AI infrastructure.

zh.title: 三星向Nvidia和KKR支持的AI基础设施公司注入10亿美元
zh.summary: 三星电子及其附属公司正向Helix投资10亿美元，这是一家由KKR支持的AI基础设施公司，因为他们在全球AI基础设施领域的投入不断扩大。

title: Anthropic leaders to control AI lab to promote public good over market forces: Reuters
summary: Anthropic's IPO filing reveals a new "Founder LLC" governance structure designed to prioritize public good over market pressures while keeping company leadership in control.
content: Anthropic's IPO filing shows how it is creating a new "Founder LLC" vehicle aimed at serving the common good, while insulating its leaders from market forces.

zh.title: Anthropic 领导者将控制人工智能实验室以促进公共利益而非市场力量：路透社
zh.summary: Anthropic 的 IPO 申请文件披露了一个新的"创始人有限责任公司"治理结构，旨在优先考虑公共利益而不是市场压力，同时保持公司领导层的控制权。

title: Anthropic’s potential $2 trillion IPO comes with the following fine print
summary: Anthropic's IPO prospectus reveals over 10-fold revenue growth in 2025, but rising costs for training and serving AI models pose profitability challenges.
content: Anthropic’s revenue grew over 10-fold in 2025, but the cost of training and serving its models is also climbing.

zh.title: Anthropic 潜在的 2 万亿美元 IPO 附带以下细则
zh.summary: Anthropic 的 IPO 招股说明书显示 2025 年收入增长超过 10 倍，但人工智能模型的培训和服务成本上升对盈利能力构成挑战。

title: Anthropic warns AI may pose 'existential risks to humanity' in IPO filing: Reuters
summary: Anthropic plans to warn IPO investors that advanced AI could pose "catastrophic or existential risks to humanity" in its regulatory disclosures.
content: Anthropic plans to warn IPO investors that advanced AI could pose “catastrophic or existential risks to humanity.”

zh.title: Anthropic 在 IPO 申请中警告人工智能可能对人类构成"存在风险"：路透社
zh.summary: Anthropic 计划在其监管披露中警告 IPO 投资者，先进的人工智能可能对人类构成"灾难性或存在性风险"。

title: Luckin Coffee, flush with investor cash, weighs entry into Middle East markets
summary: Luckin Coffee, backed by sovereign wealth funds, is exploring expansion into Middle East markets while deepening its footprint in Southeast Asia.
content: Luckin is weighing a push into Middle East markets while deepening its foothold in Southeast Asia, with backing from sovereign wealth funds in both regions.

zh.title: 瑞幸咖啡资金充足，考虑进入中东市场
zh.summary: 瑞幸咖啡获得主权财富基金支持，在探索进入中东市场的同时，加深在东南亚的业务布局。

title: Burnham to unveil public body to invest in electricity grid
summary: The U.K. prime minister will announce a new public investment body aimed at reducing energy costs during his first Labour conference speech as party leader.
content: The prime minister will say he wants to reduce energy costs in his first conference speech as Labour leader.

zh.title: 伯纳姆将推出公共机构投资电力网络
zh.summary: 英国首相将在担任工党领袖的首次党代会演讲中宣布一个新的公共投资机构，旨在降低能源成本。
